valueSideCrossCheck.what: W4.md §6 G-3's cross-check leg and §4's execute-no-write row: the value-side idiom this gate mirrors one repo upstream, run unmodified against the published 4.0.0 tarball. Its purpose here is to witness that the idiom is LIVE and DISCRIMINATING.
valueSideCrossCheck.reading: NOT a defect of this unit and NOT a defect of 4.0.0. `scripts/ci/verify-packed-surface.mjs` carries `tranche-u`'s post-X-W9 expectation set, in which X.W9.b retired the matrix family from /transform; published 4.0.0 predates that cut and still ships nine names. The idiom refusing a tarball whose surface differs from the expected one is exactly the property G-3 borrows. Recorded for X.P.W4.c: RC-P conjunct 1 PUBLISHED(V) is measured FALSE at V=4.0.0 by this very command, at this seat's clock.

causes.measured: `typescript/package.json` declares `files: ["./dist"]` and an `exports` map of five subpaths — `.`, `./core`, `./diagnostics`, `./packrat`, `./utils`. There is no `./css` subpath, and `dist/` is gitignored build output that does not exist in the tree. `npm pack --ignore-scripts` therefore ships entryCount 1: package.json alone. 0 of 52 symbols can resolve because the consumer's node_modules holds no code at all.

With the subpath declared and `src/css` shipped (the positive control), the installed runtime still fails to load: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'tsx' imported from node_modules/@mkbabb/parse-that/src/css/lowering-js/js-alg.mjs`. `src/css/lowering-js/js-alg.mjs:23` holds `import { tsImport } from "tsx/esm/api"` and `src/css/bounds.mjs:834` holds `require_("tsx/esm/api")`. `tsx` is a devDependency of the FRESH ROOT's own manifest (COHESION §0l E-1, tsx@4.23.13) and is declared nowhere in `@mkbabb/parse-that`'s dependencies, so it is present in the source tree and absent from any consumer's install. This is precisely G-3's reason for existing: a symbol that resolves in the source tree and not in the tarball.

Even with an extension it cannot resolve from a consumer's node_modules; the declaration is not self-contained.

boundsFinding.statement: W4.md §4 File Bounds grants X.P.W4 exactly three creatable paths in the fresh root — `scripts/packed-candidate-surface.mjs`, `scripts/wasm-admission.mjs`, `scripts/rc-p-evaluate.mjs` — and no unit of this wave may write `typescript/package.json` or anything under `typescript/src/css/**`. residuals.statement: The gate's literal command is `node scripts/packed-candidate-surface.mjs --seam docs/tranches/X/parse-that/SEAM-CONTRACT.md`. X.P.W4.a runs in parallel (§4a) and its contract had not landed at this unit's last check; the runs above read the 52 rows from `evidence/W3/universe-52.json`, the artefact W4.md §3 item 1 generates the contract FROM, with the source and its sha256 recorded in every report. The script's `--seam` branch is implemented and is an ERROR, never a silent fall-through, when a named contract is absent without an explicit `--universe`. Re-running under `--seam` once the contract lands changes no symbol: the set is the same 52 by construction, and `.a`'s own G-1 checker asserts both set-differences against the same file.

W4.md §7's fresh-root cadence reads `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx eslint .`. Measured at this clock: the fresh root has NO eslint configuration and no eslint install, and `npx eslint` would install packages into a root this unit may not write; `typescript/tsconfig.json` includes only `src/` and `test/`, and no `@types/node` exists anywhere in the root, so a direct `tsc --allowJs --checkJs` over the two new `.mjs` scripts returns 23 diagnostics, ALL of them 'Cannot find module node:*' / 'Cannot find name process' — i.e. the absent @types/node and nothing about the scripts. What was run instead, and is green: `node --check` on both files, and `git diff --check` in both repositories. Recorded as a measured environment fact, not a skipped check.
